hook.line: A brand went from $0 to $400K in a month, and it wasn't from Google Ads.
hook.visual: Low-angle handheld selfie on a porch, fuzzy mic held at her chin, white text '$0 → $400K/mo' beside the mic.

beats.what: Result first: '$0 → $400K/mo' text next to the mic while she states the number
Jump cut; top title 'Business owners... this is for you' calls out the audience
Mock AI chat input bar with a typed product question appears at the mic, showing the new search habit
She turns to the article's example: brand went from 0 to 41 of 50 AI answers
Article quote card about the channel's monthly revenue pops in at the bottom
Sky-angle cut, small label 'purchase-intent queries' as she says AI buyers convert better
Steps start: top title '1. Check if you show up' while she holds up one finger
'2. Create an Answer Hub' title with two fingers
Big 'GEO' title names the practice after the steps are given
'follow me' text as she closes on the homework line

why_it_works: The revenue jump is the first sentence, so the viewer stays to learn the channel that wasn't ads
Audience callout 'Business owners... this is for you' at 5 s filters in the buyers and makes them feel addressed
The term 'GEO' is named only after the steps, so the jargon never blocks the opening
Numbered steps with finger counts give a clear structure without heavy graphics
weaknesses: Very quiet mix (-29.5 LUFS) and handheld low angles make it feel rough
Fast talking (4.35 words/s) with few captions; viewers with sound off lose most of it
Step 3 gets no title card, so the list is inconsistent
for_robert: Open with the before-and-after number as one line of text beside him, and let Fred hold up the step number (one, two, three) on his fins as Robert counts on his fingers.
